The '''NonSonic Silencer''' was manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]], and was designed to suppress the noise and flash from slugthrowers. They were custom made for a specific model, and could not be switched between models of slugthrowers.
